title: Chinese spy? Defense lawyer questions ‘pastillas’ whistleblower’s nationality
summary: A defense counsel asked a “pastillas” scam whistleblower whether he is a Chinese spy as the trial of a graft case against former immigration officials continued at the Sandiganbayan on Wednesday.
